title: Bridging the Knowledge-Action Gap by Evaluating LLMs in Dynamic Dental Clinical Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM performance across natively sourced, non-translated Chinese and English datasets (MCQs, open QA, and multi-turn clinical simulations) to evaluate native-language alignment and measure performance disparities across languages.

Evaluating models against distinct medical-cultural contexts and regional guideline ecosystems to determine if clinical reasoning capabilities successfully transfer across different cultural and regulatory frameworks.
